sn55.18:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn55.18:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
sn55.18:1.3: atha kho sambahulā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatāyo yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā devatā āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca:
sn55.18:2.1: sādhu kho āvuso, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti:
sn55.18:2.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.18:2.3: buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
sn55.18:2.4: sādhu kho āvuso, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti. dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. sādhu kho āvuso,
sn55.18:2.5: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti. saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgamana hetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
sn55.18:2.6: sādhu kho āvuso, ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.18:2.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
sn55.18:3.1: sādhu kho mārisa moggallāna, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti:
sn55.18:3.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.18:3.3: buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho mārisa moggallāna, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
sn55.18:3.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.18:3.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho mārisa moggallāna, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
